column1: # TWO-ASPECT tier-1 demo board -- 2026-08-28T0600Z hq_P -- RE-MEASURED ON THE SLICE-(b) TREE
# SCRIP 69178c73 (slice-b 89571dd7 + fd2 cure) | corpus e9a4498e7 | produced by scripts/bench_rep_loop_demos_snobol4.sh
# ⛔ ASPECT 1 is a TOTAL (startup+compile); ASPECT 2 is a SLOPE (match only). They may NEVER share a column.
# ⭐⭐ FOUR TIER-1 DEMOS NOW BEAT SPITBOL ON THE MATCH PHASE (m4 vs clean oracle, aspect 2):
#   treebank-match and claws5-match-fence are NEW rows: their sibling arm refused to converge in the
#   previous run and converged here, so these are first readings, not improvements.
# ⛔ ceo's HYPOTHESIS TESTED AND NOT SUPPORTED: the ask was to re-measure json's match gap on the
# slice-(b) tree "since your 0.086x predates it and json is capture-heavy". Re-measured:
#   Essentially unchanged. SLICE (b) DID NOT TOUCH json's MATCH-PHASE GAP, so capture-copy cost is not
#   the explanation for it. json's match phase remains ~9x behind and the cause is still unattributed.
#   (json-match's own sbl arm REFUSED to converge this run, so that row carries no multiple; its fence
#   twin is the readable one and the two tracked each other closely in the previous run.)
# ⚠️ THE REFUSALS MOVED BETWEEN RUNS AND THAT IS ITSELF A FINDING: previous run refused
#   treebank-match/sbl and claws5-match-fence/m4; this run refuses json-match/sbl. All three are the
#   FASTEST arms on the board (~400-1900 ns per match), where an 8% convergence tolerance sits close to
#   timer and scheduler noise. The refusals are therefore a property of the RAMP at the fast end, not of
#   those demos. ⛔ Left as refusals rather than loosened: a tolerance widened until it stops refusing is
#   a tolerance chosen to produce answers, which is the failure direction this harness exists to avoid.
# ⭐ THE OTHER HALF OF THE READING IS UNCHANGED AND IS THE CAMPAIGN'S REAL TARGET: on ASPECT 1 we lose
#   EVERY row (m4 3-4x behind the oracle on the small demos) while winning four of them on ASPECT 2. On
#   these demos our loss is STARTUP+COMPILE, not matching.
